Data:Leiter.stanislav.mission.stone.reme.desc: 'A priest always needs a god. And all my previous gods have been lost, or superseded, or grown disappointing. Let's see how these oldest, newest gods work out.'

Data:Leiter.yvette.foe.ys.json.desc: 'Dr Yvette Southey; Yvette of the line of Ys; Yvette ferch Kelemdu; Daughter of the Marches, Daughter of the Sea. I know it's all true, but I refuse to take it seriously. I have a doctorate in medicine from a fairly decent university. I have three books on Jung out that no-one will buy. I have a mynah-bird that will only speak German. All these things are true. I suppose, after all. There are many Histories.'

Data:Leiter.yvette.json.desc: Yvette doesn't really know what she is doing here at the Institute. Yvette fears she might be a pawn. One day, Yvette will be something unexpected.

Data:Leiter.zachary.ally.chandler.json.desc:
'I think I met the Chandler once. In London. And then in the Mansus. And then in London, again...
She was always kind to me. And so I think it is me that will be the one to remember her.'

Data:Leiter.zachary.foe.chandler.json.desc:
'I think I met the Chandler once. In London. And then in the Mansus. And then in London, again...
She was always kind to me. But I think it is me that will be the one to end her.'

Data:Leiter.zachary.foe.nowhere.json.desc: 'I have spoken with Worms. It is easier than you would think - for me at least - because of my passenger. But not easy. Most of them, I destroyed. Of course. But one of them… now she is like me.'

Data:Leiter.zachary.json.desc: Zachary sits miserably silent in meetings, clearly troubled at the direction the Institute has taken. 'I must stay cold,' he whispers sometimes.

Data:Leiter.zachary.mission.peace.json.desc:
'Spencer went down.
One day I will follow him.
Then it will be quiet.
Until then, when I am silent, I will be silent for the Lighthouse Institute.'

Data:Leiter.zachary.mission.revelation.j.desc:
'Spencer went down.
One day I will follow him.
Then I will be free.
Until then, when I choose, I will make my choices for the Lighthouse Institute.'

Data:Lens.json.label: Lens
Data:Lens.json.desc: Thomas Dewulf, called Baron Silence, built the observatory at Brancrug. He was known to pay well, but his requirements were so exacting that no lensgrinder would work with him twice.

xexts.scrutiny: There's a story that Serena Blackwood took a specimen of this rose to the Invisible Serapeum when she left. There's another story that it's the unexpected component of a secret Keeper-level recipe for the Great Ink Porphyrine...

Data:Lesson.giribrago.json.label: A Lesson of Many Facets
Data:Lesson.giribrago.json.desc: Light leaks in where, from, how. [An unusual and versatile lesson that will NOT PERSIST PAST DAWN. Use it quickly.]

Data:Lesson.hint.json.label: A Lesson in...?
Data:Lesson.hint.json.startdescription: [I can't do anything with this on its own - perhaps I wanted to Consider a matching Skill so I could increase it?.]

Data:Lesson.json.label: Lesson
Data:Lesson.json.desc: One step on Wisdom's staircase. [Use this to gain or improve a Skill.]

Data:Letter.numa.invocation.porphyrine.k.label: Compose a Petition to the Beach-Crow
Data:Letter.numa.invocation.porphyrine.k.startdescription: With the proper arts and signs - and the proper encaustum - a Librarian of the House might find a way to attract the direct attention of an Hour. The Beach-Crow has no dominion over Numa - no Hour does - but he knows it better than some. Perhaps he will find the season.
Data:Letter.numa.invocation.porphyrine.k.desc: The design is complete. To travel via the Way of the Lower Skies, it must be sanctified with the proper seal, by one charged with the delivery of messages of import...

Data:Letter.numa.invocation.porphyrine.m.label: Compose a Petition to the Sister-and-Witch
Data:Letter.numa.invocation.porphyrine.m.startdescription: With the proper arts and signs - and the proper encaustum terminale - a Librarian of the House might find a way to attract the direct attention of an Hour. The Sister has no dominion over Numa - no Hour does - but she knows it better than many. Perhaps she will bring the season.
Data:Letter.numa.invocation.porphyrine.m.desc: The design is complete. To travel via the Way of the Lower Skies, it must be sanctified with the proper seal, by one charged with the delivery of messages of import...

Data:Letter.numa.invocation.porphyrine.r.label: Compose a Petition to the Vagabond
Data:Letter.numa.invocation.porphyrine.r.startdescription: With the proper arts and signs - and the proper encaustum terminale - a Librarian of the House might find a way to attract the direct attention of an Hour. The Vagabond has no dominion over Numa - no Hour does - but she knows it better than most. Perhaps the season will follow her here.
Data:Letter.numa.invocation.porphyrine.r.desc: The design is complete. To travel via the Way of the Lower Skies, it must be sanctified with the proper seal, by one charged with the delivery of messages of import...

Data:Letter.read.json.label: Read a Letter
Data:Letter.read.json.comments: Doesn't cost Soul effort! So use only for throwaway correspondence. Tool limit is so that this recipe doesn't trigger for someone who accidentally puts a book and a calling card in.
Data:Letter.read.json.startdescription: A message for me... [Read the letter; to reply instead, add Ink at a desk.]

Data:Letter.rhonwen.act1.json.label: A Letter to the Librarian
Data:Letter.rhonwen.act1.json.desc: A letter to me from St Rhonwen's Trust. The Trust's connection with Hush House is probably benevolent, but persistently obscure.

xexts.reading．correspondence: St Rhonwen's Trust wishes to congratulate me on my appointment as Librarian of Hush House. The Trust assures me that it will provide the promised stipend each spring... but reminds me that its resources are limited, and suggests I seek local assistance in restoring the premises. 'Let us know when you're all set up and ready to receive visitors,' the letter concludes. It's signed simply 'the Trustees'.

Data:Letter.rhonwen.reply.again.hint.jso.label: A Second Reply?
Data:Letter.rhonwen.reply.again.hint.jso.startdescription: I've already replied to St Rhonwen's Trust. I can throw this other message away... or preserve it for posterity.

Data:Letter.rhonwen.reply.charming.json.label: A Charming Reply to St Rhonwen's Trust
Data:Letter.rhonwen.reply.charming.json.startdescription: 'The journey was difficult, but nothing could keep me from the House, and the place is everything I had imagined! - or will be, once I've restored it to its old glory...'

Data:Letter.rhonwen.reply.enigmatic.json.label: An enigmatic Reply to St Rhonwen's Trust
Data:Letter.rhonwen.reply.enigmatic.json.startdescription: 'The sea remains; the House remains; what else remains, we shall learn in time. I am something new, and in time I will learn what that means...'

Data:Letter.rhonwen.reply.hint.json.label: Reply to St Rhonwen's Trust?
Data:Letter.rhonwen.reply.hint.json.startdescription: [Add a Soul card to determine the tone of the letter. Not all desks allow all Soul cards...]

Data:Letter.rhonwen.reply.inquisitive.js.label: An Inquisitive Reply to St Rhonwen's Trust
Data:Letter.rhonwen.reply.inquisitive.js.startdescription: 'I am here, but my situation is precarious, and there is so much I do not yet know. Is there anything more you can tell me? Of the House, the locals, their pasts? ...

Data:Letter.rhonwen.reply.pragmatic.json.label: A Pragmatic Reply to St Rhonwen's Trust
Data:Letter.rhonwen.reply.pragmatic.json.startdescription: 'The journey was not straightforward, but here I am. Hush House is empty and peaceful. Nothing walks these halls. If something once did, seven years ago... the fire must have purged it.'

Data:Letter.rhonwen.reply.straightforwar.label: A Straightforward Reply to St Rhonwen's Trust
